Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 4. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost

Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 5. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 6. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 7. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 8. Warranty Successful bidder will have to ensure that adequate number of dedicated technical service personals / engineers are designated / deployed for attending to the Service Request in a time bound manner and for ensuring Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period, as per Service level agreement indicated in the relevant clause of the bid. 9. Compliance with Technical Specifications The bidder shall supply the items strictly in accordance with the item-wise technical specifications, dimensions, quantities a nd descriptions specified in the BOQ and uploaded technical specification document. The offered items shall meet all the sti pulated requirements. Any deviation from the specified requirements shall be clearly indicated in the technical bid. 2. Technical Documents The bidder shall submit product catalogues, technical datasheets or manufacturer literature for the offered items, clearly in dicating the product name, model/reference number, dimensions and relevant technical features required for verification of compliance with the specifications. 3. Compatibility with Existing Equipment

For items requiring compatibility with existing equipment, the bidder shall furnish documentary evidence of compatibility wi th the concerned equipment/system. In particular, the light cable shall be suitable for the existing Richard Wolf laparoscopic light source system, and the bipolar cable shall be compatible with the existing Medtronic electrocautery system, as ed in the BOQ. The offered items shall be suitable for their intended use with the respective equipment. 4. Reusable Instruments and Accessories Where the item is specified as reusable, the bidder shall provide the manufacturer's instructions for use, including applicabl e cleaning, disinfection and sterilization procedures. The supplied instruments shall be suitable for the intended clinical appl ication and shall be accompanied by the relevant instructions for safe handling and reprocessing. 5. Quality and Condition of Supply All items shall be new, unused and free from manufacturing defects at the time of delivery. Refurbished, repaired or used it ems shall not be accepted. The supplied items shall conform to the applicable specifications and quality requirements relev ant to their intended use. 6. Quantity and Completeness of Supply The supplier shall deliver the quantities specified against each BOQ line item. Items supplied in boxes, sets or packs shall c onform to the pack size and configuration specified in the respective BOQ line. Where a separate line item specifies compati ble tips or accessories, the supplier shall ensure that the supplied items meet the stated compatibility requirements. No stitution or variation in quantity, pack size or configuration shall be made without prior approval of the competent authority, in accordance with the contract conditions. 7. Inspection and Acceptance The supplied items shall be subject to inspection by the designated authority of the hospital to verify their identity, quantity , dimensions, technical specifications, physical condition and compatibility, wherever applicable. Acceptance shall be subjec t to satisfactory verification against the published BOQ, technical specifications and applicable contract conditions. und damaged, defective or non-compliant shall be dealt with in accordance with the contract terms. 8. Delivery The supplier shall deliver the items within the delivery period specified in the GeM contract. The materials shall be properly packed to prevent damage during transportation, handling and storage. The supplier shall provide the delivery ce, packing details and relevant product documentation along with the consignment. 9. Warranty and Defective Items The warranty, if applicable, shall be as specified in the GeM bid/contract and the applicable GeM conditions. Any item found defective or not conforming to the accepted specifications during the applicable warranty period shall be dealt with in accor dance with the contract terms. 10. Statutory and Regulatory Compliance

The supplied items shall comply with applicable Indian statutory and regulatory requirements, wherever applicable to the re spective product category. The supplier shall provide relevant compliance documents or licences where required under app licable law. 11. Verification of Technical Compliance The technical evaluation shall be carried out with reference to the specifications and eligibility conditions published in the G eM bid. The purchaser reserves the right to verify the authenticity of submitted technical documents and seek clarifications in accordance with the applicable GeM provisions and bid conditions. No new technical criterion shall be introduced after bid publication. 12. General Conditions All other terms and conditions, including payment, applicable penalties, dispute resolution and contractual obligations, shall be governed by the GeM bid, the resulting contract and applicable GeM/Government of India procurement provisions. In cas e of any inconsistency, the applicable GeM provisions and the published bid/contract conditions shall prevail. Pre-Bid Meeting and Voluntary Equipment/ Instruments Display 1. A pre-bid meeting will be held at Medical Stores office, ESIC Model Hospital, Rajajinagar, Bengaluru - 560010 he requirements, specifications and other terms of this bid to prospective bidders. 2. All prospective bidders are invited. Attendance is voluntary. Non-attendance shall not affect the eligibility, cceptance of any bid. 3. Interested bidders may, if they wish, display or explain the equipment at the pre-bid meeting for the sole purpose of clarif ying specifications and queries. Such display or explanation is optional and shall not form part of the technical valuation. 4. Queries may also be submitted through the GeM bid query facility 5. Replies to queries and the minutes of the meeting will be uploaded on GeM, as a corrigendum or clarification where appli cable, so that they are available to all bidders equally. 6. Bid evaluation shall be based only on the specifications, documents and eligibility conditions stated in the bid document, as modified by any published corrigendum. 7. No sample or demonstration shall be called for after the opening of bids for the purpose of evaluation. 8. Bidders shall bear their own cost of participation. The Hospital will not reimburse any expense or accept any liability for e quipment brought for display. .
